card.name: Partway through drug and medical terms
card.fires_on: Fires on a single piece inside a longer word or short phrase in drug labels, such as the K in a brand name, "est" in anesthetics, or "lox" in ciprofloxacin. It also fires on small words like "the", "of" and "e" in "e.g.".

modes.label: Inside drug names
modes.description: A middle piece of a brand or generic drug name or of a class name.
modes.example: The toxic effects of local an<<est>>hetics are additive.

modes.label: Small words in clinical phrases
modes.description: Short words like "the", "of", "e" in set phrases.
modes.example: all electrical activity in<< the>> brain may cease
